# Grokipedia

> > A comprehensive reference encyclopedia covering firearms and ballistics, music and popular culture, linguistics and etymology, with detailed technical and historical information.

Grokipedia provides in-depth articles on diverse topics including Winchester rifle cartridges and ammunition specifications, music history from disco to heavy metal, and linguistic elements from Proto-Indo-European roots to modern suffixes. The site emphasizes technical accuracy, historical context, and cross-disciplinary knowledge.

## Key Topics

- Winchester rifle cartridges
- Ballistics and ammunition
- SAAMI specifications
- Etymology and word formation
- Proto-Indo-European linguistics
- Billboard chart performance
- RIAA certifications
- Greek and Latin language roots
- Varmint and big game hunting
- Centerfire cartridge design
- Music history (1946-2009)
- Suffix formation
- Model 70 and Model 88 rifles
- Wildcat cartridge development

## Firearms and Ammunition

- [.308 Winchester](https://grokipedia.com/page/.308_Winchester): Winchester's 1952 centerfire cartridge related to 7.62×51mm NATO
- [.243 Winchester](https://grokipedia.com/page/.243_Winchester): Winchester's 1955 dual-purpose varmint/medium game hunting cartridge
- [.276 Enfield](https://grokipedia.com/page/.276_Enfield): British experimental 7×60mm cartridge from Royal Small Arms Factory
- [.22 Winchester Centerfire](https://grokipedia.com/page/.22_Winchester_Centerfire): 1885 Winchester rimmed centerfire cartridge for Model 1885 rifle
- [.17-223](https://grokipedia.com/page/.17-223): Wildcat rifle cartridge necked down from .223 Remington by Vern O'Brien

## Music and Popular Culture

- [(Get Your Kicks on) Route 66](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Get_Your_Kicks_on)_Route_66): Bobby Troup's 1946 R&B song celebrating U.S. Route 66 highway
- [(Shake, Shake, Shake) Shake Your Booty](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Shake,_Shake,_Shake)_Shake_Your_Booty): KC and the Sunshine Band's 1976 disco hit reaching Billboard #1
- [(Hey You) The Rock Steady Crew](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Hey_You)_The_Rock_Steady_Crew): 1983 hip-hop/electro single by Rock Steady Crew on Charisma/Virgin
- [(Nothing But) Flowers](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Nothing_But)_Flowers): Talking Heads 1988 track from Naked album on environmental themes
- [...Twice Shy](https://grokipedia.com/page/...Twice_Shy): Great White's 1989 double-platinum breakthrough album on Capitol Records
- [(sic)nesses](https://grokipedia.com/page/(sic)nesses): Slipknot live video from 2009 Download Festival at Donington Park

## Linguistics and Etymology

- [-graphy](https://grokipedia.com/page/-graphy): Noun-forming suffix from Greek denoting writing/recording processes
- [-nik](https://grokipedia.com/page/-nik): Yiddish/Russian agentive suffix popularized during Sputnik era
- [*PriHyéh₂](https://grokipedia.com/page/*PriHy%C3%A9h%E2%82%82): Reconstructed Proto-Indo-European goddess of love by Mallory/Adams
